results.fact: Direction of travel across the plateau
results.correct_value: From the top of the switchbacks the trail runs west across the plateau (final stretch to the tarns turns north); itinerary 'east' is wrong. pro_tips 'north ... to the twin tarns' is consistent and left alone.
results.evidence: The Forest Service trail page says the plateau trail continues westward into the Mount Baker Wilderness. The encyclopedia entry places the summit west of Artist Point at the west end of the mountain (48.848, -121.714 vs the trailhead at -121.693), matching the row's own pins. WTA describes following the south rim and then going north to the tarns, so the pro_tips 'north' wording is not a contradiction; only the itinerary's 'east' is wrong.

results.evidence: Sources do not agree on where the switchbacks top out. The Forest Service says the plateau is reached after less than a mile; SummitPost (via search summary) describes about 600 ft of gain up the southeast face to the eastern plateau over about 1.0 mi one way; WTA gives only 725 ft total gain and a 5,700 ft high point; 10adventures says switchbacks start at 0.5 km. No two sources confirm either the approach's ~400 ft / 0.4-0.5 mi or the beta's 0.6-1 mi / ~5,700 ft plateau figure, so no patch.

results.correct_value: No pets are allowed on the Table Mountain Trail
results.evidence: The Forest Service (land manager) page states no pets are allowed on the Table Mountain Trail; WTA lists dogs not allowed; 10adventures says dogs are prohibited. results.fact: Drive time Bellingham to Artist Point
results.correct_value: About 58 miles / roughly 1.5 hrs from Bellingham
results.evidence: A Washington tour guide gives 59 miles and an estimated 1.5 hours from Bellingham to Artist Point; another Artist Point guide says the drive from downtown Bellingham takes about an hour and a half. Bellingham's tourism site notes the highway ends at milepost 58 at the Artist Point lot, consistent with the row's own 34 + 24 mi. The ~1 hr / ~53 mi hospital figure is the outlier.
